edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the recipient of _safeMint inside mintShrooms
block.timestamp is an entropy input to the pseudo-random id generation, creating timestamp dependency
_getRandomId produces the weak randomness modeled by the unsafe operation
The weak random id is consumed by mintShrooms to choose which token is minted
tokenPrice is one operand of the price multiplication
User-controlled numberOfTokens is the other operand of the price multiplication
The multiplication result feeds the msg.value requirement in mintShrooms
numberOfTokens bounds and drives the mint loop in mintShrooms
mintShrooms reads the saleIsActive gate
mintShrooms checks the _currentTokenId supply counter
mintShrooms limits number of tokens by maxPurchase
mintShrooms enforces the MAX_NFT_SUPPLY cap before minting
mintShrooms invokes _getRandomId for every token iteration
_safeMint inside mintShrooms performs an external call to the receiver hook before the transaction settles
_getRandomId mutates and reads the _randomOffset collision counter
_getRandomId reduces entropy modulo MAX_NFT_SUPPLY
Local id holds the random value produced by _getRandomId
msg.sender receives the remaining balance in withdrawAll
withdrawAll reads the constant devAddress as a payment target
withdrawAll performs value transfers to external addresses, transferring control outside the contract
devAddress is the destination of the first transfer in the withdrawal operation
Local balance caches the contract balance used by withdrawAll
getReserves reads the reservesTaken guard
getReserves reads and increments _reserveIndexCounter
getReserves enforces the MAX_NFT_SUPPLY cap
msg.sender is the beneficiary of the reserve mints
revealMetadata sets the metadataRevealed flag
finalHash parameter is stored by revealMetadata
metadataHash parameter is stored by revealMetadata
setBaseURI writes the _baseURI state variable
baseURI parameter is forwarded to _setBaseURI by setBaseURI
flipSaleIsActive sets saleIsActive to true
tokenURI reads the _baseURI state variable
_tokenId parameter is encoded into the returned URI
_owner parameter selects which balances are enumerated
Local tokenCount sizes the result array in tokensOfOwner

normalization_plan.reason: numberOfTokens is only meaningful as the loop bound and payment factor inside mintShrooms
finalHash is written directly into the FinalProofHash state by revealMetadata
metadataHash is written directly into METADATA_IPFS_HASH by revealMetadata
baseURI parameter is immediately forwarded to _setBaseURI inside setBaseURI
_tokenId parameter is only used to build the token URI string
_owner parameter is only used to look up balances and owned token indices
balance is a transient cache of address(this).balance used solely by withdrawAll
id is the transient holder of the generated random value inside _getRandomId
tokenCount is a transient cache of the owner balance inside tokensOfOwner
randHash is a transient holder of the random id used inside the mintShrooms loop
